method: Manual editorial clarification of existing hypothesis titles; no new observed event, empirical cause, prevalence, outcome or clinical/legal guidance. Initial drafts reviewed to remove motive and building-layout assumptions.

changed_entries.title: I spend long stretches at home without a conversation
changed_entries.context: Contact needs to fit a day spent largely at home, with few chances for conversation.

changed_entries.title: The drinks I like are not within reach
changed_entries.context: Drinking depends on having a preferred drink close enough to get without help.

changed_entries.title: Someone handling my money uses it in ways I did not agree to
changed_entries.context: Money is being managed in ways that do not match the person’s consent.

changed_entries.title: I cannot tell which messages or websites are scams
changed_entries.context: Unclear warning signs make it difficult to judge whether a digital message is safe to act on.

changed_entries.title: I have stopped wanting to do things I used to enjoy
changed_entries.context: Activities that previously mattered no longer feel worth starting.

changed_entries.title: I struggle to handle practical affairs while grieving
changed_entries.context: Practical responsibilities still need attention during the disruption of grief.

changed_entries.title: The person who helped with daily tasks is no longer here
changed_entries.context: Daily tasks still need doing after a regular source of help is lost.

changed_entries.title: I cannot bring the belongings that make a room feel like mine
changed_entries.context: A new room needs to feel familiar even when valued belongings cannot be brought along.

changed_entries.title: I find a new routine difficult even when someone explains it
changed_entries.context: Understanding an explanation does not make a changed daily routine easy to follow.

changed_entries.title: If I fall, I may not be able to reach the phone
changed_entries.context: Help needs to be reachable even if a fall leaves the person unable to get to the phone.

changed_entries.title: Extreme indoor temperatures make a home visit unsafe for the person or me
changed_entries.context: Temperature conditions in the home create a safety concern during a care visit.

changed_entries.title: The person wants to take a risk that my manager expects me to prevent
changed_entries.context: The worker must reconcile the person’s choices with the manager’s safety expectations.

changed_entries.title: A person avoids drinking because they fear wetting themselves
changed_entries.context: Fear of an accident affects whether the person accepts drinks offered during care.

changed_entries.title: A monitoring alert reaches me without enough context to decide what to do
changed_entries.context: An alert gives a signal without the details the worker needs to choose a response.

changed_entries.title: Smoke exposure in a client's home makes it difficult for me to provide care
changed_entries.context: Providing care requires staying in a home where smoke affects the caregiver.

changed_entries.title: I am expected to work in a room with infestation and no agreed precautions
changed_entries.context: The worker is expected to enter an infested room before protective arrangements are clear.

changed_entries.title: I cannot find a less physically demanding role without leaving care altogether
changed_entries.context: Physical demands make the worker seek a different role while wanting to remain in care.

changed_entries.title: The working height makes me bend for long periods during care
changed_entries.context: Care tasks require prolonged bending at the available working height.

changed_entries.title: I am expected to teach a colleague while covering my usual workload
changed_entries.context: Teaching a colleague competes with the care tasks already assigned to the worker.

changed_entries.title: I observe a worrying change but do not know the agreed escalation threshold
changed_entries.context: A change causes concern, but the worker lacks a clear threshold for seeking further help.

changed_entries.title: Potential volunteers leave because induction and checks take too long to complete
changed_entries.context: The service loses potential volunteers before induction and checks are complete.

changed_entries.title: Residents cannot find their way through the building without becoming distressed
changed_entries.context: Residents need help orienting themselves while moving through the building.

changed_entries.title: A suspected information breach has no clear response owner
changed_entries.context: A possible information breach needs action, but responsibility for the response is unclear.

changed_entries.title: Rising operating costs outpace the income from agreed services
changed_entries.context: The provider must cover rising costs while service income remains tied to existing agreements.

changed_entries.title: Residents or relatives cannot get a clear explanation of who sees their information
changed_entries.context: People want to understand access to their information, but the provider cannot explain it clearly.

changed_entries.title: We cannot compare proposed systems against the work staff actually need to do
changed_entries.context: System selection is difficult without comparing proposed features with actual staff tasks.

changed_entries.title: I cannot release staff for training without leaving the floor short
changed_entries.context: Training attendance competes with the staffing needed to keep everyday care running.

changed_entries.title: Energy-saving changes make rooms uncomfortable for residents
changed_entries.context: Reducing energy use creates a conflict with keeping residents’ rooms comfortable.

changed_entries.title: We receive referrals without enough information to judge whether we can meet the person's needs
changed_entries.context: Accepting a referral requires a clearer picture of the support the person needs.

changed_entries.title: After a resident dies, practical tasks leave no time to support relatives or colleagues
changed_entries.context: Practical work after a death competes with attention needed by relatives and colleagues.

changed_entries.title: I cannot arrange visits from the religious or community supporters my relative trusts
changed_entries.context: Trusted spiritual or community contact is wanted, but arranging access is difficult.

changed_entries.title: The food recommended for my relative is food they will not accept
changed_entries.context: Recommended meals conflict with the foods the relative is willing to eat.

changed_entries.title: We have no agreed plan for what happens if I can no longer be the main carer
changed_entries.context: Caring arrangements depend on one main person without an agreed replacement plan.

changed_entries.title: I cannot work out the ongoing total when several care services charge separately
changed_entries.context: Separate service bills make the combined recurring cost difficult to estimate.

changed_entries.title: I cannot reach timely professional advice during a difficult night
changed_entries.context: A difficult night leaves the family without advice in time to decide what to do.

changed_entries.title: A change happens at night and I cannot obtain advice that fits the symptoms
changed_entries.context: The family needs guidance about the particular symptoms when a change happens overnight.

changed_entries.title: I cannot tell whether new pain needs emergency care or a routine appointment
changed_entries.context: The family is unsure which route to use when pain appears or changes.

changed_entries.title: Every conversation with my parent becomes about what they cannot do
changed_entries.context: Attention stays on lost abilities, leaving little room to discuss what still matters to the parent.

changed_entries.title: A bank will not accept the authority I thought allowed me to act
changed_entries.context: Helping with banking is blocked when the bank does not recognise the family member’s authority.

changed_entries.title: Staff interpret my relative's cultural preferences as refusal or difficulty
changed_entries.context: The relative’s cultural preferences are not being understood as intended during care.

changed_entries.title: Blocked exits or clutter leave no safe way to move during a home visit
changed_entries.context: Clutter or blocked routes prevent the worker from moving safely through the home.

changed_entries.title: An aggressive pet prevents me from reaching the person safely
changed_entries.context: Pet behaviour makes approaching the person unsafe during the visit.

limits: Hypotheses stay hypotheses; plain editorial context is not validation or measured demand.
42 context updates: older adult10, family10, worker12, provider10. 392 generic situation contexts still remain.
Only navigation summaries and review provenance changed. Titles, status, research planning, evidence, hierarchy and media preserved.
Home-visit safety branch still needs solution research and empirical evidence; its five contexts are complete, not the research branch as a whole.
Image generation remains paused; neutral fallback is temporary and does not complete the media requirement.
No public UI deployment. Full backups and mutation manifests retained privately; 1319 mapped identities unchanged.
